|lore=Mysterious bounty hunter of an unknown species. Rumored to be somewhat telepathic. Infrequent member of Jabba’s court. Plotting to kill Jabba.
|game_text=Once per game, you may add X to a Force drain, where X = the value of X on Firepower (V). While at a battleground, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses at same and related planet sites may not be canceled. Blaster Rifle is a “matching weapon” for Bane. Immune to attrition < 3.
|errata_history={{Card errata/Bane Malar (V) (Virtual Set 7)}}
|printings={{Card versions/Bane Malar}}
|notes=The Players Committee released Set 7 on 16 July 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946id_/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The October revision adds the requirement that Bane be at a battleground to protect the existing same and related planet sites. The remaster restricts the geographic protection to here and the same site as Ree-Yees, removes the Firepower bonus and raises deploy to 3. Blaster Rifle stays a matching weapon and immunity remains below 3.  The October article displays its own publisher slip. The later composite, reconstruction and slip remain available as source files.
